original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input image 1 is the approved canonical portrait and is the strict identity, age, hairstyle, clothing, accessory and rendering reference. Produce ONE landscape close-up 3D character turnaround sheet, THREE evenly sized head-and-shoulder portraits of this SAME character, in one horizontal row, ordered LEFT TO RIGHT: (1) exact straight FRONT view, (2) exact 90-degree SIDE PROFILE facing the RIGHT edge of the canvas, (3) exact 180-degree BACK view. This is a modeling reference sheet, not three different people. Rotate the entire head and shoulders together; never turn the face back towards camera. The middle view shows ONLY one eye and a clean nose/lips/chin silhouette with the far eye hidden. The back view shows the back of the head, hairstyle and upper shoulders, with NO eyes, face or nose visible. All cameras exactly at eye height, no looking down/up, zero head tilt, orthographic-like 85mm perspective. Same head scale, top-of-head line and shoulder crop across the three panels. Close framing from the complete top of hairstyle/headdress down to upper chest; no waist, hands, full body or feet. Leave a small white top margin, keep all heads and ornaments uncropped, separated by clean white space. Landscape approximately 3:1 wide canvas, high detail. Preserve exact approved facial features, eye color, hair color, skin texture, apparent age, expression, outfit details and accessory placements; generate plausible consistent hidden rear construction without adding new ornament themes. Match the reference's premium realistic-stylized 3D modeled game cinematic look: dimensional facial sculpting, subtle skin microtexture, strand hair, PBR cloth and metal, balanced soft neutral studio light. Pure opaque white #FFFFFF background edge to edge in all panels. No text, labels, borders, separator lines, watermarks, UI, shadows on backdrop or extra panels. Do not beautify into a different identity.
